data.essence: Editorial B2B fashion confidence: precise, calm, and product-led.
visual_principles: Show existing product and identity proof before decorative imagery.
Use structured editorial composition and generous space.
Make limitations and source context legible where claims could be inferred.

photography.style: Reuse only the approved hero and App Store reference assets in this run; no new image generation is authorized.

forbidden_visuals: Synthetic body or garment claims presented as product proof.
Social-first clutter or unapproved palette expansion.
